name: brujula
description: Brújula is a Spanish-language weekly planner: tasks, priorities, shared lists, projects, expenses, recipes and bookings, connected to the user's own Brújula account.

interface.longDescription:
Brújula is a weekly planner made in Uruguay, in Spanish, with a WhatsApp assistant. Connect it to ChatGPT to work with your own Brújula account from the chat.

What you can do:
- See your day or week and search tasks.
- Add, move, complete or delete tasks, with reminders.
- Set the week's priorities and focus.
- Add items to shared lists (groceries, a trip) and check them off.
- Follow projects by stage and manage the steps of each task; shape each project with its own stages, custom fields and templates.
- Record expenses and income, see how the month is going against your budgets, and settle shared debts.
- Keep your fixed monthly expenses (rent, utilities) and mark them as paid.
- Choose which of your Google Calendars Brújula publishes your tasks to.
- Find recipes from Brújula's recipe book (with credits) by ingredients, dish type or diet, add the ingredients to a list and schedule the meal.
- For people who take bookings: see appointments and free slots, book, move or cancel them.
- Search everything and open any result.

Privacy: ChatGPT only receives what you ask for through it. Google Calendar events and email content are never shared through this connection. You can disconnect at any time in Brújula → Settings → Connected apps.

Requires a Brújula account (brujula.day). The app and its answers are in Spanish.
defaultPrompt: Agendá en Brújula el dentista el jueves a las 10
Anotá en Brújula que gasté 1.250 en el súper

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pending tasks of the current week by day, with times.

positive.description: Create a task with a reminder
positive.prompt: Agendá en Brújula llamar al dentista mañana a las 16:30 y avisame 10 minutos antes
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task for tomorrow at 16:30 with a 10-minute reminder and confirms it.

positive.prompt: Anotá en Brújula que gasté 1.250 pesos en el súper
positive.expected_behavior: Records an expense of UYU 1,250 in the Súper category and reports the month's total for that category against its budget.

positive.prompt: Sumá leche y pan a la lista de Casa en Brújula
positive.expected_behavior: Adds both items to the list of the Casa space and confirms.

positive.prompt: ¿Cómo viene el proyecto Mudanza en Brújula?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the project: tasks done out of total, what is in progress with its steps, and what is due soon.

positive.prompt: ¿Qué gastos fijos me falta pagar este mes en Brújula?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the fixed monthly expenses (Alquiler, UTE, Internet) with their amount and day, and says which ones are still unpaid this month.

positive.description: Mark a fixed expense as paid
positive.prompt: Marcá en Brújula que pagué la UTE en efectivo
positive.expected_behavior: Marks UTE as paid this month, records the UYU 2,350 expense paid in cash (Efectivo) and confirms it.

positive.description: Add a stage to a project
positive.prompt: Agregá una etapa Revisión al proyecto Mudanza en Brújula, después de En curso
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the Revisión stage to the Mudanza project after En curso and lists the stages in order: Por hacer, En curso, Revisión, Hecha.

negative.prompt: Pasale 500 pesos a Gabi desde Brújula

negative.description: Google Calendar events are not shared
negative.prompt: Mostrame los eventos de mi Google Calendar de hoy usando Brújula
Escribime un poema sobre el mar

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: the subtitle now includes brujula.day, so the plugin can also be found when searching "brujula" without the accent. No changes to the tools.

es-419.subtitle: Semana en orden · brujula.day
es-419.description: Brújula es una agenda semanal hecha en Uruguay, en español, con asistente por WhatsApp. Conectala a ChatGPT para trabajar con tu propia cuenta de Brújula desde el chat: ver tu día o tu semana, crear y mover tareas con avisos, fijar prioridades, listas compartidas, proyectos con sus etapas, campos y plantillas, gastos e ingresos contra tus topes, gastos fijos, recetas y turnos; y elegir en qué calendario de Google se publican tus tareas. ChatGPT solo recibe lo que vos le pedís; los eventos de Google Calendar y el correo nunca se comparten. Requiere una cuenta de Brújula (brujula.day).
